title: Ya Mustafa ya mustafa
body:
Ya mustafa, ya mustafa..(2)
Ya mustafa salle alaa..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Mehbub e haq, khair ul bashar
islaam ke baani nabi
shams uz zoha, badr ud duja
noor e khuda, shaane wali
zakhmi hai dil, zakhmi jigar
ye jaanta hai kab koi
wo ghum mile hai aapko
sakte mein hai saara jaha'n
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa salle alaa..(2)
Ya mustafa, ya mustafa..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Pyaare nabi ya mustafa, har aankh hai girya kuna
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa, ya mustafa..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Kya Mustafa ne ghum sahe
duniya ko kab maloom hai
sab ke liye rehmat hai jo
khud kis qadar mazloom hai..(2)
qurbaan sab kuch kar diya
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa, ya mustafa..
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Patthar use maare gaye
jo rehmat e kaunain tha
daef ki galiyo mein lahoo
behta raha, behta raha..(2) phir bhi nahi ki baddua
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa, ya mustafa..
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ye sochte hai mustafa
aghosh mein shabbir hai
khanjar rawa gardan pe hai
zakhmi badan mein teer hai..(2)
ayegi ek din karbala..
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa, ya mustafa..
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Beti pe mere baad phir
har zulm dhaaya jayega
mohsin shahadat payega
ghar ko jalaya jayega..(2)
subbat ilayya ki sadaa
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa, ya mustafa..
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Hasnain hai girya kuna
nana ki mayyat dekhkar
baba chale hai chhod kar
zehra ka hai muztar jigar..(2)
ab kya karegi fatima
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa, ya mustafa..
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Haider ki aankhein ashk hai
taboot mein hai mustafa
zehra akeli rehgayi aur puchti hai maamta..(2)
wo shaam, kufa, karbala
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa, ya mustafa..
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Zainab ke lab par thi sada
lut kar madine aagaye
kurta liya shabbir ka
marqad pe nana ki chale..(2)
mehshar bapa hone laga
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa, ya mustafa..
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Lega wo badla zulm ka
ek din Mohammad aakhri
uski museebat likh sake
haq hai ali safdar yehi..(2)
maine qamar nauha likha
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa, ya mustafa..
